{{Short description|Estonian chemist (1921–2018)}}

[[File:Tullioilomets.jpg|thumb|Tullio Ilomets]]
'''Tullio Ilomets''' (13 July 1921 – 22 August 2018<ref>Tullio Ilomets - Society of Estonian Conservators http://www.eestikonservaator.ee/tullio-ilomets-2/</ref>) was an Estonian chemist, science historian and a volunteer in heritage protection.

==Education==

Born in [[Paide]], Ilomets graduated from Paide Secondary School in 1941.<ref>Mati Narusk "Tullio Ilomets – Tartu vaimu varahoidja" Maaleht, February 16, 2016 http://maaleht.delfi.ee/news/lehelood/koik/tullio-ilomets-tartu-vaimu-varahoidja?id=73623477</ref><ref>Madis Jürgen "Tullio Ilomets ongi Tartu Vaim" Eesti Ekpress, November 11, 2011 http://ekspress.delfi.ee/kuum/tullio-ilomets-ongi-tartu-vaim?id=49511875</ref> He continued to study chemistry at the [[Tallinn Polytechnic Institute]] (1946-1948) and [[Tartu State University]] from 1948-1952. He has served as faculty member and research fellow with the University of Tartu Department of Chemistry's institute of organic chemistry since 1952. He earned a candidate's degree in chemistry and became associate professor in 1965 and associate professor emeritus in 2007.<ref>Tartu Riikliku ülikooli õppeteaduskoosseisu bibliograafia nimestik, 1944-1980, Биобиблиограйический список преподавательско-науч-
ного состава Тартуского государственного университета в 1944 - 1980 гг., Tallinn: Valgus, 1987, pp.290-291.</ref>

==Science history and academic heritage==

Ilomets was one of the founders of the Academic Heritage Society and is an honorary member of the Estonian Heritage Society. He was a member of the Society of Estonian Conservators.<ref>Tullio Ilomets - Society of Estonian Conservators http://www.eestikonservaator.ee/tullio-ilomets-2/</ref>

In the 1960s, Ilomets began to collect and store, in the basement of the University of Tartu main building,<ref>University of Tartu main building http://www.ut.ee/en/university/general/sights-and-museums/main-building</ref> discarded science equipment and memorabilia linked to the history of the university. In 1976, the basement collection lead to the creation of the [[University of Tartu Museum|University History Museum.]]

Ilomets, as of 2016 with his 95 years, was the oldest working employee at the University of Tartu.<ref>Kristjan Roos "Tartu ülikooli vanim töötaja, 95-aastane Tullio Ilomets on kui ülikooli alussammas", Õhtuleht, September 15, 2016 http://m.õhtuleht.ee/759285/tartu-ulikooli-vanim-tootaja-95-aastane-tullio-ilomets-on-kui-ulikooli-alussammas</ref><ref>Tullio Ilomets, University of Tartu, http://www.ut.ee/en/tullio-ilomets</ref>

==Awards==
*2001 - [[Order of the White Star]] third class
*2001 - Honorary Citizen of [[Tartu]]<ref>Tartu linnalt tunnustusavalduse saanud isikud - http://tartu.eu/?page_id=967&lang_id=1&menu_id=6&lotus_url=/Tunnustus.nsf/Web/kategooria/92EBC455AA87484242256B5D004BFDC8</ref>
